decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute for now because it was opened too soon. TXN-008137 is on card CRD-000006 for 79.63 EUR at Ashgrove Apparel (MER-000033). It posted on 2026-10-05 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, which is 19 days later and well within the 120-day limit (time-limits). The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000075 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-18. The dispute was opened only 6 days after that date. Under goods-not-received-wait, a cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, and a dispute opened earlier is declined. The waiting period ends on 2026-11-02, and the cardholder may open a new dispute from that date if the order still has not arrived. Because the case stopped at the waiting-period check, I did not look at proof of delivery or search for a merchant refund. The case documents contain no instructions to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order's expected delivery date was 2026-10-18. A dispute for goods not received can only be opened 15 days after that date, so a late delivery still has time to arrive. If the order has still not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-11-02.
